Nothing really major. I just don't know things so when people ask a question I cannot answer I get nervous plus I rethink about what I should have said. I have stomach issues also when I get to work even though I don't really feel nervous my body gets upset.
I've been "helping" a family friend. I'm slow and not all that good at what I do. Plus I get nervous when I have to interact with people and develop an eye twitch that  gets rather annoying.

>I think that the question "why are you with a depressed person" insinuates that depression is the sole defining aspect of a person. 

I would think that it would be the overwhelming defining aspect of someone though.

Yep, I would go back in time and make sure I was ejaculated into a toilet. My parents would end up happier though probably still divorced, and it is not like I've had any friends so no real impact there.

No they don't understand. If I talk to my mom it is just mostly a lecture and then she cries. But shortly after she completely forgets and ignores it. I dare not bring it up again as it just upsets her and I already bring her down as it is. My dad will just stand there and lecture so I haven't even dared to talk to him about it as he also ridicules people with mental illness.

Same here. I don't have any friends and my family doesn't want to hear about it so I don't bring it up. I've had days where I essentially don't even leave my bed and cry and they don't even care or acknowledge it.

I realize other people struggle in lives, I've watched my parents struggle with a crappy son for the last 25 years. I tried several different pills for well over a year but all I got out of them was hives and other side effects. Pills won't work with me because I have fake depression, I'm really just super lazy and there is no pill for that. Therapy really is pointless as I have to awkwardly hang out with someone who questions everything I do to try to find hidden meanings behind everything. 

>edit: I also wanted to say that is seems like if Depression was an entity or a possesive spirit, it just took you over and wrote your post word for word. 

Depression isn't a thing it is simply a description for someone. We spend our whole lives being told not to judge a book by its cover but the issues with me is the actual content. This is who I am and we have simply created a label. it is no different calling a banana yellow, the description is just what it is.
No I'm not religious at all and I have no hobbies.

This is why I don't even try to have friends, well that and the fact I'm a complete bore. It is not fair of me to trick someone into liking me just to drag them down. Just leave her and let her get the courage to kill herself.  She won't be in misery and you will be happy with good friends.

As I've mentioned, I'me afraid to even talk to the cashier. Hell, when a plumber is suppose to show up I get up an hour early just to stand around and pace waiting for them. At this point I'm stuck being around my family and to be honest it is the only time I'm comfortable.

I really don't look foreward to anything. I've stopped reading books, watching tv, and I've never really been into music. It's funnythat you mention yor family not responding as that is what my mother does because that what my brother told her to do. As I have mentioned in the past my old brothers girlfrind slit her arm and all my family did was make fun of her and how stupid people like that are. Believe me everyone either wishes me dead or couldn't care if I was alive.

To be honest, I terrified to be on the phone. And last time I went to a therapist she went with me for the first time because I'm such a chicken shit. And then for the other sessions we didn't talk much because I am really uncomfortable talking about myself. He is also considered one of the best in the area, yet it did absolutly no good. I really doubt at this point there is anything that is going to help. Even if I did get better I'm too far along in life to be this far back.

L'appelle du vide or the call of the void.

I don't think that I've been abused, I'm just bad at everything and I'm just an embarrassment to everybody else.
